90103446c3a6251f.description: Product Manager, Advanced Enterprise Data Platform Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role. 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc). Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in a technology or business related field. Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure. Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross-functional stakeholders. Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long-term product roadmaps. Deep knowledge of AI/ML foundations, RAG, and semantic modeling. Ability to define platform success metrics from user feedback while ensuring strict data privacy and security compliance. About the job At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Googles data landscape into an AI-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross-functional domains to drive product-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Googles next generation of agentic intelligence. At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Googles IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers. Responsibilities Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem. Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges. Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide-ranging enterprise requirements. Engage directly with domain owners to lead platform adoption, optimize common capabilities, and achieve product-market fit. Define satisfaction metrics through user feedback while navigating ambiguity to maintain enterprise standards and high-impact delivery. Experience Level Mid Level .
